states.owner_baseline: Water heat exchangers meet specified supply-water temperature conditions including HRHX 30C with 20-45C range, other HX 27C +/-5C and exceptional low-temperature conditions.

alat.summary: Requests later definition of range and cites non-adaptable standard HP-compressor heat exchangers.
alat.owner_disposition: Baseline already defined; require performance envelope or formal deviation/equivalence.

states.owner_baseline: ISO 9001 QMS and project NC/change/configuration controls continue through warranty and after-sales services including maintenance, repair, modification and upgrade.

alat.summary: Accepts warranty only; excludes maintenance under another contract/entity.
alat.owner_disposition: Reject temporal/scope reduction; require after-sales QMS responsibility chain.

states.owner_baseline: FAT includes contractual minimum dimensional, pressure/leak, E&I, operability, hydraulic, rotating-equipment, controls/HMI, QCR and documentation checks.

alat.summary: Changes minimum to where-applicable, substitutes preliminary ITP/standard and omits specified compressor/motor performance/vibration/noise FAT checks.
alat.owner_disposition: Reject blanket substitution; require clause-to-ITP crosswalk and approved equivalent for moved tests.

states.owner_baseline: Abnormal-event SAT covers backup utility switching, helium recovery, valve/interlock logic and abnormal-event response including LOOP.

alat.summary: Limits combinations to proposal tests and removes at-minimum floor.
alat.owner_disposition: Preserve four behaviour classes; optimized matrix only with complete coverage and Owner approval.

states.owner_baseline: CIS SAT proves PLC/SCADA failover/restart/recovery, restoration of control functions and preservation/orderly recovery of states, alarms and operator functions.

alat.summary: Moves evidence into abnormal-event tests and removes at-minimum wording.
alat.owner_disposition: Potentially acceptable only with explicit traceable coverage, stimuli, expected states, timing, logging and pass/fail criteria.
